name: Sälen

seo.title: Sälen ski resort guide
seo.description: Sweden's largest ski resort by lift count: 105 lifts and 101 slopes across four areas on one SkiPass, and a family favourite since 1975.
seo.twitterDescription: 105 lifts, 101 slopes, four areas on one SkiPass.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, slope grades per area, where to stay and how to get to Sälen in Dalarna, Sweden.

h1: Sälen ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Sälen is four ski areas on one SkiPass, and together they hold 105 lifts and 101 slopes - more of both than anywhere else in Sweden. Lindvallen and Högfjället are where beginners go, Tandådalen has the Big Air Arena and the most difficult slopes, and families have been coming here since 1975. The Vasaloppet starts in the valley below.

kpis.label: Runs
kpis.note: across four areas on one SkiPass

stayOverview: The four areas are far enough apart that the one you book decides your week. Lindvallen has the adventure pool and the evening skiing; Hundfjället has ski-in ski-out at SkiStar Lodge and the troll forest; Högfjället is the hotel, the afterski and nine green and blue slopes; Tandådalen is the snowpark and the steep end.
hotelIntro: Book against high season rather than today's date, and pick the area before the bed: the ski bus is included with the SkiPass but the walk to the lift is not the same from all four.
rentalCars: A car helps for moving between Lindvallen, Hundfjället, Högfjället and Tandådalen, though the ski bus between them is included with the SkiPass. From winter 2026/27 Snälltåget runs to Mora with a transfer bus onward.

travelTips.title: Which area
travelTips.text: Högfjället is entirely green and blue, Tandådalen has seven difficult slopes. Pick the base that matches who is skiing.
travelTips.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Sälen lifts, slopes and weather

travelTips.title: Evening skiing
travelTips.text: Magic Mountain runs every day at Valleberget in Lindvallen, with a light show.

travelTips.title: Two resorts on one pass
travelTips.text: A SkiPass of three days or more in Sälen includes two days in Trysil across the Norwegian border.

travelTips.title: Train from 2026/27
travelTips.text: Snälltåget runs to Mora with a transfer bus onward to Sälen.

highlights.title: Lindvallen
highlights.text: The largest of the four areas, with 24 of its 42 slopes graded very easy or easy and an adventure pool with waves and a FlowRider.
highlights.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Sälen lifts, slopes and weather

highlights.title: Magic Mountain
highlights.text: Evening skiing at Valleberget with a light show, running every day of the season.

highlights.title: Tandådalen Big Air Arena
highlights.text: The snowpark sits on the sunny side, in the area with the most difficult slopes in Sälen.
highlights.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Sälen lifts, slopes and weather

highlights.title: Trollskogen
highlights.text: A run through a troll forest at Hundfjället, built for children.

highlights.title: Högfjället
highlights.text: Six lifts and nine slopes, all green or blue, with the hotel, the afterski and the nightclub.

highlights.title: Vasaloppet start

topElevation.unannounced: SkiStar publishes the vertical drop but no summit elevation for Sälen, also not on the rendered slopes page.

season.note: Lindvallen opens first on 4 December; Högfjället, Tandådalen and Hundfjället follow on 11 December and close 11 April. The operator's season-opening page gives the same start.

baseElevation.unannounced: The operator gives 105 lifts, 101 slopes and 303 m of vertical across four areas, but states no altitude above sea level for the foot of any of them.

longestRun.unannounced: The operator counts the slopes in each of its four areas but publishes no run lengths and names no longest run.

dayPass.unannounced: SkiStar prices the SkiPass by booking date and states it is cheapest the earlier it is booked, so there is no fixed adult day rate.

facts.text: Högfjället is entirely green and blue: 7 very easy slopes and 2 easy, and nothing harder.
facts.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Sälen lifts, slopes and weather

facts.text: Lindvallen has 24 of its 42 slopes graded very easy or easy, plus a children's area and an adventure pool with waves and a FlowRider.
Families have skied here since 1975, and Trollskogen lets children ski through a troll forest.
Tandådalen has 7 difficult slopes, the most of any area in Sälen, from wide carving runs to steeper skiing.
facts.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Sälen lifts, slopes and weather

facts.text: The Big Air Arena is at Tandådalen.
facts.sourceLabel: SkiStar: Sälen lifts, slopes and weather

unannounced.statement: SkiStar does not publish a fixed adult day rate: the SkiPass is priced by booking date, and the operator states it is cheapest the earlier it is booked.
